title: Rental-Implied Depreciation of AI Accelerators: replication package (code, results and paper)
description: Code, result tables, figures, decision and assumption logs, and the working paper for Rental-Implied Depreciation of AI Accelerators: Why the Estimates Disagree. An open panel of 24,210 listing-months of posted GPU rental prices (NVIDIA V100 to B200, 2017-2026), four identification strategies for the age-price profile, asset values and economic life, and a seven-firm earnings restatement. `make all` rebuilds every table, figure and the paper from the archived raw files. The raw files whose sources permit redistribution and the public panel are deposited as a separate Zenodo dataset; the rest are re-fetched by the repository's collectors, with checksums in release/raw_manifest.csv. Code is MIT-licensed; the dataset is CC BY 4.0. See README.md.
